scope: Three fixed first-order spherical HLL/Heun runs before collapse. Error includes finite-volume and time discretization against a numerically evaluated similarity reference. The active norm uses the predetermined r >= 0.8 r_shock region, alongside full-volume norms.
diagnostic_only: Density and pressure Linf near the shock are retained without requiring monotonic decrease.
History shock positions use the pressure-gradient peak in a fixed analytic-radius window; they are finite-resolution diagnostics.
Sound-speed-only roundoff-guard evaluations are counted separately from state repairs, including repeated face/CFL evaluations of the same negative cancellation-band pressure.
No convergence at the collapse singularity, reflected branch, or actual two-dimensional perturbation is tested.
